titular: **Kill** on attempt 8: 324 s at 264k group DPS with only 5 deaths. The night’s average DPS (198k) was lower than that of Cry’s usual group (218–244k). The difference was survival: all 7 real attempts broke the stagger and **every one passed 53%**.

recomendaciones.titulo: The key was reaching the second half alive.
recomendaciones.texto: Each player’s first death came between 129 and 223 s on average. On the usual group’s nights, between 92 and 142 s. That’s why these attempts lasted about 270 s and the usual group’s between 144 and 172 s: with no deaths in the zone phase (140–175 s), the damage is enough.
All 7 real attempts broke the stagger between 94 and 142 s. Same pattern as every night: no break, no progress.

recomendaciones.titulo: 1802720 didn’t appear in the kill attempt.
recomendaciones.texto: It killed 10 players over the night and came in 5 attempts (210–353 s), but not in the kill. This supports the idea that it punishes a failed mechanic rather than being a timed enrage.

recomendaciones.titulo: The final phase can be survived.
recomendaciones.texto: 1802980 and 1802981 (past 70% HP removed) appeared in attempts 4, 7 and 8 and killed 3 players over the night. In the kill they came at 219 s and the group held through all of it.

Posey: Top DPS (62.8k, 73k in the kill) plus 2.7k support HPS and 70% of hits from behind. The night’s benchmark.
3 of your 9 deaths are from 1802720 (506k taken, 169k hits). In attempts without it, you barely die.
Stalo: 52.4k DPS (60k in the kill) with a 68% crit rate.

You die the earliest in the group (first death at 129 s on average, 3 deaths before the 60-second mark). 2920717 (1802830) killed you 3 times: it appears around 45–100 s, leave it as soon as you see it.
Nadoriel: 49.8k DPS as tank (61k in the kill) and a first death at 184 s on average.
In the kill attempt you went down at 133 s to 1802880 (195k). Rahu casts it around 26–30 s and again around 126–135 s: keep a defensive for that second cast.
Cry: 38.9k DPS and 4.8k HPS. Your first death comes at 223 s on average; with your usual group, at 131–142 s. With this group you’re still alive in the final phase, and your healing carries the kill.
No deaths before the 60-second mark. 1802880 killed you twice (144k): when it targets you, a timely self-shield makes the difference.
Lux: Your DPS (22.5k, 24k in the kill) is less than half of everyone else’s. Review your rotation and gear: you have the lowest GS (2865, CP 175k).
You die the most (16). 1802840 killed you 3 times and 2920719 (1802870) twice in the kill attempt itself, at 162 and 168 s. In the zone phase, prioritize surviving.

notas.texto: This run was with a different group from Cry’s usual one (Lux, Nadoriel, Posey and Stalo).
Boss 2301008 died on the first try in 207 s. Then there were 5 attempts on boss 2301014, no kill.
Lasted 5 s with no damage or deaths: a failed pull, not a real attempt.
